svg.title: LoRA: a frozen matrix and a thin trainable detour
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “LoRA: a frozen matrix and a thin trainable detour” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A large hachured grey matrix W labelled frozen, holding 16.8 million parameters that never move, and beneath it a much thinner green path through two rank-eight matrices A and B holding 65,536 trainable parameters. Both paths meet at a sum node; the highlighted line underneath reads 0.39 percent trainable.
